description: About a second after the detail panel opens, a 'Here now' presence row is inserted above the summary line, shifting the summary, GitHub issues, Status and everything below down by ~36 px. The person's own avatar is also added to the card.
expected: Panel content is stable once it renders; presence space is reserved or shown inline with the heading.
actual: Late-inserted 'Here now' row causes a layout shift right after create (compare screenshots/step-4.png and screenshots/step-5.png).
suggested_fix: Reserve the presence row height, or render presence inline next to Close; consider not showing the viewer's own avatar as 'Here now'.

description: With the detail panel open, the same sync status 'Saved locally · synced' appears in the header and directly under the task heading, and the viewer's own presence appears three times (header avatar, panel 'Here now', card avatar).
expected: Sync state shown once; own presence not repeated.
actual: Two identical SaveStatus lines and three self-presence markers on one screen.
suggested_fix: Drop the panel SaveStatus unless it differs from the header (e.g. pending for this task only); hide self from 'Here now'.

description: An empty board shows 'No tasks here' in all seven columns with no hint toward New task.
expected: A first-run empty board suggests the next step (e.g. 'Create your first task' in Backlog).
suggested_fix: When the whole board is empty, show one call-to-action in Backlog and leave the other columns blank.
